youtube_film.description_lead:
One stand, two colours. Grbavica, Sarajevo, 21 September 2024: Željezničar's home end lights the night red in the first half and fills the ground with blue smoke after the break. Zrinjski Mostar win it 0–2 with two late goals.

I WAS THERE is FAN LIFE's matchday blog — real nights, filmed from the stand. Every fact comes from the FAN LIFE archive.
